items.resolution: Repeated watch configuration replaces its copied range and clears old hit; one-shot hit disarms and explicit rearm never repeats the completed store.
Caller serializes operations on one instance; independently configured instances can advance interleaved with no observer cross-talk.
Unclassified assumption: common-tick guest observations, snapshot bytes and normalized digests must match across restore/watch/slices; forged rehashed states refuse unchanged.
Unclassified assumption: all16 route cases and actual CPU request controls prove software routing; unavailable device/readback policy remains hardware-unverified.
A payload ending exactly at10000 succeeds; one byte beyond refuses; buffers merely touching instance bounds are disjoint, any shared byte refuses.
NULL/zero input and header-only length10 refuse; length11 with one payload byte is accepted if range-valid.
Preflight validates instance/size/overlap then complete header/range before power-on/copy; ambiguous malformed inputs never partially apply.
Adjacent source containers retain distinct whole-object identities and per-run startup tags; no host address parameter merges identities.
Missing or empty startup tag refuses manifest validation; no content cannot publish a success manifest.
Manifest keys are emitted in one fixed documented order; duplicate tags or conflicting startup aliases are refused.
Unclassified assumption: unavailable ROM and absent firmware API controls prove supported-interface limits, not arbitrary input rights.
Unclassified assumption: no-run/real broken guest/timeout/result corruptions must fail distinct semantic completion criteria.
Unclassified assumption: exact independent pixel/palette/sample/metadata checks prove a diagnostic SNAPSHOT, not video accuracy.
Exclusive staging and no-replace atomic publication allow at most one complete winner; refusals preserve preexisting output bytes.
